name: Stability AI API
tagline: Generative AI API for image, video, 3D, and audio models from Stability AI
description: Stability AI provides a REST API for accessing generative models including Stable Diffusion for image generation/editing, Stable Video Diffusion, 3D generation, and audio models. Developers authenticate with API keys and call endpoints at api.stability.ai for text-to-image, image-to-image, upscaling, and related generative tasks.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header (self-serve signup on platform.stability.ai)

rate_limits: 150 requests per 10 seconds; exceeding it returns HTTP 429 and triggers a 60-second timeout.

example.request: curl -s -X POST "https://api.stability.ai/v2beta/stable-image/generate/core" -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Accept: image/*" -F "prompt=a lighthouse on a cliff" -F "output_format=png" --output lighthouse.png
example.response_snippet: Binary image bytes (PNG/JPEG/WebP) when Accept: image/*; or JSON with base64 when Accept: application/json

use_cases: generate an image from a text prompt
edit or inpaint an existing image
generate a short video from an image
remove background from a product photo
